raw.query: SELECT engine, n_images, mean_ms, aic_pred_ms FROM provenance.collector_encoder_fn WHERE image_px = 448 AND n_images IN (1, 64) AND is_valid ORDER BY engine, n_images;
raw.evidence: The claim uses analytic performance model predictions (engine='aic') instead of actual physical measurements. Under standard standard PyTorch (engine='sdpa'), physical execution is much slower (11.22ms and 511.26ms), resulting in only a 1.40x throughput gain.
